Xia Ding used his wings to protect Ah Li and turned into a stone figurine. 100 years later, during thunder and lightning, the stone cracked and gave birth to a boy. Ji Chang happened to be passing by and adopted him as his godson, naming him Lei Zhenzi. Though burdened by her past, she begins to find a glimmer of hope as she encounters the kindness of the people there. But as if to sneer at her peaceful new life, the calamity Nergal appears once more. The very despair that once reduced her homeland to ashes now threatens to steal the light from this land as well.
